deviations.deviation: pooled = sum of the nine per-shift timebudget runs (seconds, jobs, spans summed; shares and jobs_per_robot_hour recomputed from the sums)
deviations.reason: serial moroop-amr-1 has no Z<zone>- prefix, so every shift is zone ''; one timebudget run over all nine files would have read_messages drop shifts 2-9 as duplicate (serial, headerId) and merge them into one robot

deviations.deviation: reported (disjoint true/false per id pair), not asserted
deviations.reason: the brief says report, do not fail; docs/LITERATURE.md Part 2b section 4 said assert

deviations.deviation: a stuck run is the half-open [start ts, ts owning-end of its last message); the hit window [label start, label end + 30 s] and the false-alarm window [run start - 30, run end + 30] are closed at the far end; label episodes are half-open [floor(first ts), floor(next None ts))
deviations.reason: the brief gives intervals without endpoint conventions

deviations.deviation: an episode with no later 'None' row ends at the last emitted message's timestamp
deviations.reason: 'stream end' in the brief; the bucket grid ends there

deviations.deviation: seconds = the interval each kept message owns (next kept ts - ts), no_data intervals included
deviations.reason: the brief asks rows and seconds per state / operating_mode value without a gap rule

deviations.deviation: the bucket of an owned interval is taken from timebudget.robot_budget called on the pair (message i, message i+1); stuck vs stopped_short for the 'anywhere else' case is then decided with timebudget.stopped_runs / run_is_stuck on the full stream
deviations.reason: reuse the precedence instead of rewriting it; the per-bucket second counts are asserted equal to the timebudget output

mapping.rule: floor to whole seconds, UTC, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'; keep the LAST native row of each second
1..n contiguous over this shift's emitted messages; never the dataset id (gaps in id are screening removals)
constant 'moroop-amr-1' (no Z<zone>- prefix, so parse.zone_of gives zone '')

job_id of the operation running at the kept row's native created_at (start_time <= t < finish_time; null start or finish never runs); none running but the last finished operation before t and the next starting one after t share a job -> that job; two running -> latest start_time wins, second counted in overlap_seconds; job_type 'charging' -> ''
hypot(velocity_x, velocity_y) > 0.05 m/s OR abs(velocity_omega) > 0.05 rad/s (strict); never state == 'Navigating'
[] always; diagnostics status levels are tabulated only; stuck_reason, TIMEOUT and operation_start_denied are never errors
[] (no payload column in the robot state)

per current_position_id in 135 charging / 136 warehouse / 137 kitting / 138 assembly, every cell (same grid) holding >= 5 % of the state == 'Idle' cleaned rows at that id, pooled over nine shifts; shelves []

src.timebudget_runs: one per shift: fleet/timebudget.py --glob fleet/data/moroop/jsonl/zone<k>-000.jsonl.gz --run moroop-<shift> --stations fleet/data/moroop/stations.json
